noteWhereNote.message: A note on the whole site appears on every page of it, at the same place on each.

setDefaultHint.message: Every new note starts like this one

setCustomHint.message: Custom. Click to follow the default again.

extDescription.message: Sticky notes that stay stuck to the page — not to your browser. Offline, private, and yours to export.

cmdToggleTab.message: Turn notes on or off for this tab

menuNoteOnSelection.message: Add a note on this text

updatesDenied.message: Access to the release list was not granted, so there is nothing to check against.

optSettingsLiveNote.message: Every setting is in one place, and this is not it. The cabinet holds where notes appear, how they look, what happens when a tab closes, how long the trash is kept, backup, the language, and the whole keyboard reference. This page is what Firefox opens from its add-ons list, so it keeps the way in, the version, and the two notes below about what your notes survive and what leaves your machine — which is nothing.

mgrEmptyHint.message: Stick a note on a page and it files itself here.

mgrNoMatchHint.message: Try fewer words, or clear the search.

mgrTrashHint.message: Deleted notes wait here for 30 days.

popNoAccess.message: Chevalet Note has no access to this site yet.

guardWillWarn.message: Will warn before this tab closes.

guardBestEffort.message: Close warnings are best-effort: browsers only allow them on pages you have interacted with. Your notes are saved either way.
guardBestEffort.description: Shown in options next to the close-warning setting. Must not over-promise.

guardModeUnsaved.message: Warn if there are unsaved edits

guardModeHasNotes.message: Warn whenever the page has notes

durabilitySurvives.message: Your notes survive clearing your browsing data.

durabilityLost.message: They are lost by "Refresh Firefox" or by uninstalling the extension — which is what the ZIP backup is for.

cabEditNote.message: Markdown, the same as in the note itself. Saving keeps the previous text as a version, so History can put it back.

cabEmptyAll.message: Stick a note on a page and it files itself here.

cabTrashNote.message: Deleted notes wait here for 30 days.

cabNoMatchNote.message: Try fewer words, or clear the search.

cabNoteMayBeGone.message: The note may have been deleted.

cabVersionGone.message: That version is no longer in the database.

cabExportZip.message: Everything: text, positions, colours, drawings and images. The only one that can be imported back into this extension. Keep this one.

cabExportMd.message: One .md file, grouped by page. Opens in any editor. Loses positions, colours and drawings.

cabExportHtml.message: One file that opens in any browser, with the images inside it and nothing fetched from the internet. Good for reading and printing.

cabImportSettings.message: Also restore the settings in this archive, replacing yours.

cabHistoryOff.message: Version history is switched off in Settings → Keeping, so nothing is being kept.

themeAutoTitle.message: Colours follow your browser. Click for dark.

themeDarkTitle.message: Dark, whatever your browser says. Click for light.

themeLightTitle.message: Light, whatever your browser says. Click to follow your browser.

setShowUndecided.message: Show notes on a site I have not decided about

setShowUndecidedNote.message: Off means a site stays clean until you turn notes on for it from the toolbar button.

setKeepPrivate.message: Keep notes made in private windows

setKeepPrivateOn.message: They are written to the database like any other note.

setKeepPrivateOff.message: They live in memory only and are gone when the last private window closes.

setWarnClosingNote.message: Firefox decides whether to actually show the dialog, and a page you have not interacted with may get none. Your notes are written to the database long before this could matter, so treat it as a courtesy rather than a safety net.

setTabsWatchedNote.message: Closing a window full of annotated tabs must not ask you ten times over. The most recently edited tabs get the slots.

setColoursNote.message: The cabinet, the popup and this page. Notes keep their own paper colour — a sticky note that went dark because your system did would be a different note. There is a shortcut for this at the bottom of the cabinet.

setMovementNote.message: How much the paper tilts, swings and lags as you drag it. Following the system respects "reduce motion" in your accessibility settings. This is a ceiling: a note set to less movement of its own accord keeps it.

setNewNoteLooksNote.message: Any note can still be changed on its own — press S on a note, or use the sliders button in its header — and a note keeps whatever it changed even when you alter the defaults here.

setTypeNote.message: Six of these are bundled with the extension and load only when a note uses one, so they look the same on every machine. The two System entries use whatever your computer has.

setTextSizeNote.message: The same range a single note offers, so a default can never be a size a note could not be.

setDirectionNote.message: Automatic lets each paragraph decide for itself, so Persian and English can share a note.

setAutoDelete.message: Let old notes be deleted automatically

setAutoDeleteOff.message: Off, so nothing is ever destroyed unless you empty the trash yourself. The trash simply grows, which costs almost nothing.

setAutoDeleteOn.message: Trashed notes are destroyed once their time is up. The sweep runs four times a day, and a trashed note carrying no deletion date is never destroyed.

setKeepTrashedNote.message: Counted from the day a note went into the trash, and it keeps the whole of its last day. Does nothing while the switch above is off.

setVersionsZero.message: Zero, so nothing is kept and the History button will have nothing to show. Undo in a page still works; it just does not survive closing the tab.

setVersionsSome.message: Select one note in the cabinet and press History to read them, or put one back. A version is kept when an edit is more than thirty seconds after the last one, or changes the length by a couple of hundred characters — not on every keystroke, or the list would be unreadable. The oldest are dropped past this number.

setExportNote.message: Export… in the bar above works now and needs no permission at all. It contains every note, its position, its style and its images, as one archive you can keep anywhere.

setDownloadsGone.message: Firefox has withdrawn permission to save files, so this cannot run. Switch it off and on again to ask for it back.

setLanguageNote.message: The whole interface — the cabinet, the settings, the popup and a note’s own panel. Notes keep whatever you typed in them, in whatever language you typed it.

setCheckDaily.message: Check for a new version once a day

setCheckDailyNote.message: The only network request this extension can make. Off unless you turn it on, and it asks permission the first time. No cookies, no referrer, nothing about you — it reads the release list and compares one version number.

keyNoteSettings.message: This note’s settings — colour, type, size, direction, paper

keyTickTask.message: Tick or untick the task on this line

keyHeading.message: Heading — again for a smaller one, again for none

keyFinishWriting.message: Finish writing and select the note itself

keyUndoAll.message: Undo — typing, colour, moving, resizing, drawing, deleting, in order

keyRedo.message: Redo — Ctrl + Shift + Z as well

keyAltDouble.message: Make a note where you clicked

keyRightClick.message: Add a note here, or on the selected text

keyNewNoteMiddle.message: Stick a note in the middle of the page

keyToggleTab.message: Turn notes off, or back on, for this tab

keyFocusNext.message: Move focus to the next note on the page

keyFirefoxOwns.message: Firefox keeps these bindings itself, and only Firefox can change them: about:addons → the gear at the top right → Manage Extension Shortcuts. Whatever you set there is what this list shows.

keyCannotOpen.message: Firefox will not let an extension open that page. Copy about:addons into the address bar yourself, then use the gear at the top right → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

keySelectedExplain.message: Grabbing a note’s header selects the note, which is the state the single-key shortcuts work in. Clicking its text puts you in the editor, where the Ctrl chords apply and every plain key is just a letter. Escape takes you from the text back to the note.

keyNoCtrlU.message: There is no Ctrl+U: markdown has no underline, so there is nothing for it to produce that a note could render. Ctrl+Shift+M and Ctrl+Shift+K are left alone as well — those are Firefox’s own, for responsive design mode and the console.

setBackupNotNote.message: What this is not: it cannot choose the folder — the browser decides that — it cannot run while Firefox is closed, and a file on the same disk is not an off-site backup. It survives Refresh Firefox and uninstalling the extension. It does not survive the disk failing.

keySeeThrough.message: See through the notes, and click the page under them
